# Wanderwork Dashboard Project

This is a React + Vite + Tailwind CSS project implementing the Wanderwork dashboard design from Figma.

## Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Create copilot-instructions.md file
- [x] Scaffold React + Vite + Tailwind project
- [x] Implement Figma design components
- [x] Install dependencies and compile
- [x] Launch development server

## Tech Stack
- React 18
- Vite
- Tailwind CSS
- TypeScript

## Components Created
- Sidebar with navigation menu
- JobList with search and filters
- JobDetails with full job information

## Running the Project
- Development: `npm run dev` - Opens at http://localhost:5173
- Build: `npm run build`
- Preview: `npm run preview`
